questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of checking analytics like views, watch time, and engagement metrics for your online content?

options.text: To compare your stats with popular creators and feel discouraged
To understand how your audience interacts with your content and identify what works or flops
To ignore the numbers and focus only on making random videos
To change your niche every week based on small changes in data

correct_answer.text: To understand how your audience interacts with your content and identify what works or flops

questions.question_text: How can insights about your audience, such as their age range and active times, help improve your content on platforms like TikTok or Instagram?

options.text: They tell you to post at random times to confuse your followers
They help you create content that matches their vibe and post when they’re most likely to see it
They are useless since all audiences behave the same way
They only matter if you already have thousands of followers

correct_answer.text: They help you create content that matches their vibe and post when they’re most likely to see it

questions.question_text: Why is it important to jump on trends and understand platform algorithms when creating content for social media?

options.text: To copy every trend exactly without adding your personal style
To stay relevant, increase visibility, and get pushed to more viewers by the platform’s system
To avoid using trending hashtags or sounds that could boost your reach
To focus only on old content styles that are no longer popular

correct_answer.text: To stay relevant, increase visibility, and get pushed to more viewers by the platform’s system

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of collaborations and cross-promotions with other creators for growing your online presence?

options.text: They make your content less interesting by involving too many people
They help you reach new audiences, build creator friendships, and create fun, engaging content
They only work if the other creator has millions of followers
They are a waste of time compared to working solo on every post

correct_answer.text: They help you reach new audiences, build creator friendships, and create fun, engaging content
